resources.string: Okumenyezelwa yilolu hlelo lokusebenza, lokho isistimu ekuvumelayo, kanye nereferensi elondoloziwe ozobuyela kukho

Izinto ezimbili ezihlukene zinquma ukuthi uhlelo lokusebenza lungenzani. Imvume ye-manifest iyona ecelwe uhlelo lokusebenza - kungenzeka ukuthi isistimu ayinikile noma ayikayinikile. I-app op yilokho isistimu ekuvumelayo njengamanje: kuvunyelwe, kuzitshiwe, kukhawulelwe ekusetshenzisweni kwangaphambili, noma ukukhipha kususiwe ukuze i-manifest inqume futhi. I-Android yesimanje ihambisa ukulawula okwengeziwe kuma-ops ohlelo lokusebenza konke ukukhishwa, okuhlanganisa izinto ezingenamakhava emvume ye-manifest nhlobo - ibhodi lokunamathisela, ukudlidliza, ukwenza kwangemuva - ngakho ukubonisa eyodwa kuphela kokubili kungaba impendulo ewuhhafu ebukeka iphelele. Ukubhala i-op yohlelo lokusebenza kudinga impande lapha (noma ADB ngokusebenzisa i-Shizuku, lolu hlelo lokusebenza olungakasebenzi okwamanje), futhi konke okubhaliwe kufundwa emuva kwalokho ukuze utshelwe ukuthi idivayisi yamukelwe ini ngempela esikhundleni salokho esikuthumele. Isithenjwa esilondoloziwe siyimpendulo yenkinga yangempela: ukufaka kabusha uhlelo lokusebenza noma ukushintsha i-ROM kubuyisela yonke imvume. Londoloza isithenjwa kanye, qhathanisa kamuva, futhi ubone ukuthi yimaphi ama-ops akhukhulekile.
Ukufunda izimvume ezimenyezelwe zalolu hlelo lokusebenza kanye nama-app ops.
Izimvume eziyingozi kuphela ezibalwe: ezivamile awuzinikezi noma uzihoxise, ngakho ukuzifaka ohlwini kwengeza ubude ngaphandle kolwazi.
Lolu hlelo lokusebenza lusho ukuthi azikho izimvume eziyingozi.
Izinguquko zesistimu, njengoba kubikwe ama-appops we-cmd.
Umyalo awubuyisanga lutho esingaluhlaziya, ngakho-ke lokhu "akwaziwa" — hhayi "akukho ama-ops".
Thepha umsebenzi ukuze ukushintshe. Lonke ushintsho luyafundwa ngaphambi kokuthi lubikwe njengolwenziwe.
Khetha imodi yalo msebenzi. Yonke imodi ifundwa futhi ngemva kokubhala.
ukukhipha kususiwe, ngakho-ke i-manifest iyanquma futhi
Inqubomgomo oyibhala phansi, hhayi ukuqagela: londoloza ama-ops amanje, bese uqhathanisa noma ubuyisele emuva kwesikhathi.
Igcina yonke imininingwane ebikwa yilolu hlelo lokusebenza, kusitoreji salolu hlelo lokusebenza uqobo — ayikho impande edingekayo ukuyigcina noma ukuyifunda
Ibhala kuphela imisebenzi ekhukhulekile, bese ibika lokho idivayisi eyamukelwe
Akukho lutho olunyakazayo: wonke umsebenzi olondoloziwe usenevelu yawo elondoloziwe.

Inqubomgomo elondoloziwe iyasuswa. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ngokwazo azithintwa.
Kuvunyelwe kuphela ngenkathi uhlelo lokusebenza lungaphambili.
Lwamukelwa ucingo luthule alwenzi lutho. Uhlelo lokusebenza alutshelwa.
Ucingo luyehluleka, futhi uhlelo lokusebenza lutshelwa ukuthi lunqatshiwe.
Isusa ukukhipha, ngakho imvume ye-manifest kanye nenqubomgomo yenkundla inquma futhi.
Ipulatifomu kufanele ibuze ngaphambi kokuvumela. Akuwona wonke umsebenzi owusekelayo.
Lonke uhlelo lokusebenza kule divayisi, kanye nezimvume ezizishoyo futhi uhlelo lokusebenza lusebenza uhlelo oluvumelayo.

Akukho lutho kule divayisi olufana nalolo sesho. Isule ukuze ubone lonke uhlelo lokusebenza futhi.
